name: AHB
recent: AHB Holdings Berhad 近期有多项董事及委员会成员变动，包括 Datin Poon Lee Fah、Lim Guan Hong 及 Terence Cheah Eu Lee 的委任与辞任。公司于10月与 Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd 成立发电业务联营公司，并转移 Grid Engineering 股份。此外，两名执行董事在闭市期间以每股2仙脱售合计约7.4%股权。
notable: 与 Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd 成立联营公司，从事发电机组及电力系统相关业务，并转移 Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd 的 3,700,000 股股份。
Lim Guan Hong 于2026年11月4日获委任为独立非执行董事。
Terence Cheah Eu Lee 于2026年11月2日辞任独立非执行董事。
risks: 两名执行董事 Chow Hung Keey 与 Flavio Porro 在闭市期间以每股2仙合计脱售约7.4%股权。
公司截至2025年9月30日季度净亏损632万令吉，净利率为负47.3%。
earnings: 截至2025年9月30日季度，公司营收为1,336万令吉，环比增长82.1%；净亏损632万令吉，净利率为负47.3%，较上一季度的负0.5%大幅恶化。

recent_en: AHB Holdings Berhad has seen several board and committee changes recently, including the appointment and resignation of Datin Poon Lee Fah, Lim Guan Hong and Terence Cheah Eu Lee. In October, the company formed a power generation joint venture with Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd, transferring Grid Engineering shares. Separately, two executive directors disposed of a combined 7.4% stake at 2 sen per share during the closed period.
notable_en: Formed a joint venture with Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd for generator sets and power generation systems, transferring 3,700,000 shares in Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd.
Lim Guan Hong was appointed as Independent Non-Executive Director on 4 November 2026.
Terence Cheah Eu Lee resigned as Independent Non-Executive Director on 2 November 2026.
risks_en: Two executive directors, Chow Hung Keey and Flavio Porro, disposed of a combined 7.4% stake at 2 sen per share during the closed period.
The company recorded a net loss of MYR 6.32 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2025, with a net margin of negative 47.3%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, revenue was MYR 13.36 million, up 82.1% QoQ; net loss was MYR 6.32 million with a net margin of negative 47.3%, deteriorating from negative 0.5% in the previous quarter.
